question: Does the SIMLOX 2017 converter reject predefined <REPAIR> when it is the first subtask of a mission preparation, while that identifier is valid in a direct system repair task?

ownership.local_and_remote_arm_owner_at_selection: none found for B02.var04 predefined-required-subtask legality

accepted_parent.accepted_behavior: Two authored serial preparation subtasks: SEQ1 INSPECT h7-7.16667, SEQ2 SERVICE h7.16667-7.5, then successful h8-10 mission.

positive_control.behavior: A predefined <REPAIR> subtask is accepted within a linked direct SystemRepair task without a SubTaskType definition. This control is read only and will not be rerun.

manual.interpretation: Predefined <REPAIR> is mandatory for direct repair tasks broken into subtasks and can be used only in direct item/system repair; brackets are part of its ID. MissionPreparation links PREP-FIXED and is not a repair task.

source_delta.only_changed_cell: TaskBreakDown instance0 row0 (PREP-FIXED SEQ1) SUTID INSPECT to <REPAIR>
source_delta.retained: SEQ1 DURN 1/6 hour, SEQ2 SERVICE DURN 1/3 hour, existing custom SubTaskType rows, MissionPreparation TID PREP-FIXED and scalar DURN 0.75, one h8 mission, seed and 36-hour horizon. No user-defined <REPAIR> row is added.

predeclared_acceptance: Recheck accepted B02 and B01 source and exact parent/prerequisite raw closure seals without rerunning; pin valid B05 <REPAIR> source control and installed manual/dictionary bytes.

Require frozen one-cell source diff and exact 17 row-containing-table import/export identity before calculation. If import/export rejects, preserve the failed run but do not count it as the scoped converter result.

Require actual SSH session 0 with sshd.exe ancestry, free Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, absent unique run directory, exact responding GUI PID/session/start, stable source hashes and independent exact-file prelaunch GO.

At conversion require exactly one native error on either TaskBreakDown record 1 or linked MissionPreparation record 1. The diagnostic must identify <REPAIR>/REPAIR or the linked PREP-FIXED task and invalid subtask breakdown/preparation context; the exact code is not pre-guessed. A generic error on another form, an unidentified reference, or multiple errors is NO_GO. Only classified #108/#126 warnings may coexist.

Record the calculation process exit code whether zero or nonzero and require its converter log; the code alone neither accepts nor rejects this negative result. The calculation must not produce a substantive valid SXO or physical simulation/report. Preserve even a tiny invalid SXO and every log. No report-export attempt after the negative converter gate.

Independently replay the source bytes, full exact roundtrip, diagnostic count/context, absence of physical execution, all raw hashes and failure seals before any publication. If native accepts <REPAIR>, record a counterexample and exclude this negative contract. The v0.1.0 over-specific diagnostic gate and v0.1.1 over-specific exit-code gate remain prelaunch NO_GO, unrun and preserved by original hashes.
limits: This tests one invalid predefined subtask use in one mission preparation; it does not establish every predefined-required-subtask rule, exact error-code stability, GUI validation or cross-engine behavior.
K01/K08 GUI capture and K06 remain blocked; I07 opening-stock-three and E05.var02 exact-time remain excluded.
